arguments.content: Recovery identity must match the public operation identity. In a serialized save API whose completed recovery records remain for audit, selecting the first record by workspace permanently shadows later operation IDs. A new save can return success with the caller's new ID while neither applying its values nor creating its recovery record. Review sequential operations on the same workspace, not only repeated calls with one ID; use operation-ID lookup and derive acknowledgments from the matching record. Reproduced in service.py against the prior implementation; P1.
